QF.id: XXVA Sales and Distribution of Research Services_14

question.text: Research analyst compensation shall NOT be determined or based on:

answer.text: The quality and accuracy of research publications
Seniority and experience of the analyst
Any specific merchant banking, investment banking, or brokerage services transaction
Annual performance reviews by the research department head

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 17(1) prohibits compensating a research analyst on the basis of any specific merchant banking, investment banking, or brokerage services transaction. Regulation 17(2)-(3) requires the compensation to be reviewed annually by the board or a board-appointed committee, without considering contribution to banking or brokerage business. The Trap: The prohibition is specifically against linking pay to particular banking or brokerage deals, not against any structured compensation review. Note: The checked pages do not establish that "quality, seniority, and departmental performance reviews" are themselves listed as acceptable compensation bases — the source only describes the specific-transaction prohibition and the annual board-level review.
